hypotheses.reasoning: account-svc v1.5.0 went out at 17:41:18. About two minutes later, POST /login started throwing a TypeError in user-formatter.ts:132 (it reads 'currency' from an undefined object), and every one of these errors is tagged [v1.5.0]. The edge-proxy 500s come after this and are a symptom. The failures are partial, which fits a code path that only some users hit, probably users without the nested field that holds currency. I searched for a migration and found none.
Some user records may be missing the field that holds currency. But the errors only start after the release, so the new code is the more likely trigger.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll account-svc back to v1.4.9. Then fix user-formatter.ts:132 so it handles users who don't have that field.
